evaluation_limits: One paired generation per case and prompt; no repeated seeds or confidence intervals.
Four independent probe descriptions were designed around observed material-term failure. Not a blind held-out general-purpose corpus.
Lexical hits do not prove semantic or negation correctness, and may miss valid paraphrases.
Japanese and Korean fluency and honorific register need independent experts.
No FLORES+ parallel references were imported because existing Codespaces did not provide accepted gated access.
No change to production registry, PostgreSQL, CPU gateway or weights.
